detached_structure.evidence: A small dark structure is faintly visible at the right edge of the lot, near the tree line beside the open field. It may be a shed, but it is small and partly obscured.

signals.notes: The central house is a large gray-roofed home with a rear section partly shaded by heavy mature canopy. Dense trees cover the east and south sides of the lot, and the driveway is dark and hard to read.
